The main takeaway from our work is that

the CRBs on the phase and frequency estimates of harmonics in Gaussian multiplica- tive noise depend on the sample mean and variance of the noise, and the CRBs on these noise parameters can themselves be computed.

the achievable accuracy on the frequency and the phase estimates of harmonics in Gaussian noise is not only dependent on the signal-to-noise ratio, but also on the mean of the multiplicative and the variance of the additive noise.
the achievable accuracy of the estimates is a strong function of the noise statistics and, therefore, should be taken into account in any practical implementation of harmonic retrieval algorithms.
